items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: That’s Don Lamond, the great Don Lamond man. ... Only Don could do that. He was unbelievable.

ctx.x: Ronnie, did you play on “Beyond the Sea” is that you on that record?
No man, that’s — I wish it was. That’s Don Lamond, the great Don Lamond man.
